label: the phase 4 fallback error is truncated to an int
the +0x9c store is 32 bits wide
why: 0x3e40e is `66 89 8b 9c 00 00 00` -- `mov %cx,0x9c(%ebx)`, a 16-bit store, so the object writes two bytes and this writes four. The two it also writes are +0x9e, which `short_9e = 0;` seventeen statements later sets to 0 anyway and which nothing between the two reads. EQUIVALENT ONLY BECAUSE OF THAT ORDER: move the +0x9e store above the +0x9c one, or make anything between them read +0x9e, and this mutation becomes a real defect. It will then be CAUGHT and reported MIScounted, which is the point of registering it.
